crossRefs.note: Joshua went up from Eglon, and all Israel with him, to Hebron; and they fought against it.
They took it, and struck it with the edge of the sword, with its king and all its cities, and all the souls who were in…
Joshua came at that time, and cut off the Anakim from the hill country, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, and from…
They went up by the South, and came to Hebron; and Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were there. (Now…
They came to the valley of Eshcol, and cut down from there a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bore it on a…
Judah went against the Canaanites who lived in Hebron. (The name of Hebron before that was Kiriath Arba.) They struck…
They gave Hebron to Caleb, as Moses had said, and he drove the three sons of Anak out of there.

people.name: Ahiman
people.line: One of the giant descendants of Anak in Hebron

people.name: Anak
people.line: Ancestor of giant people in Canaan

people.name: Caleb
people.line: Faithful spy, given Hebron as inheritance

people.name: Talmai
people.line: Anakim king of Hebron, defeated by Judah

translations.web: Caleb drove out the three sons of Anak: Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.
translations.bsb: And Caleb drove out from there the three sons of Anak—the descendants of Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.
translations.kjv: And Caleb drove thence the three sons of Anak, Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.
translations.asv: And Caleb drove out thence the three sons of Anak: Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.
